title: Full life
wikitext:
'''Full Life''' is a condition that applies when the character's current [[life]] is at 100%. Full Life works when under the influence of [[Chaos Inoculation]].

__TOC__

==Interactions==
While taking [[damage over time]], the full life condition can still be met if your net life recovery is greater than the net life loss, via stats such as [[regeneration]], [[leech]], or [[flask]]s.<ref name="Full life and degen 1"/><ref name="Full life and degen 2"/> Note however that the player will still die from sufficiently much damage over time, even if their life recovery over time is greater than the life loss over time.

==Related skill gems==
{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables=skill_stats_per_level
|join=skill._pageID=skill_stats_per_level._pageID
|where=
  skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%full_life%"
|level=yes
|int=yes
|dex=yes
|str=yes
}}

==Related unique items==
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=
  item_stats.id LIKE "%full_life%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1
}}

==Related passive skill==
===Base and notable passives===
{{Query base passive skills
|where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%full_life%"
}}

===Cluster jewel passives===
{{Query base passive skills
|q_where= passive_skills.id LIKE "%affliction%" AND passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%full_life%"
}}

===Keystone passives===
{{Query keystone passive skills
|where=passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%full_life%"
}}

===Masteries===
{{Query masteries|where=mastery_effects.stat_text_raw LIKE "%Full Life%"}}

===Ascendancy passive skills===
{{Query ascendancy passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%full_life%" 
}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%full%life%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}
